seoTitle: Running Pace Converter: Min/km, Min/Mile, km/h, mph
metaDescription: Convert running pace between min per km, min per mile, km/h and mph, with 5K, 10K and marathon finish times.
intro: Converts pace or speed between minutes per kilometre, minutes per mile, km/h and mph and predicts finish times at an even pace.
why:
Races use kilometres in one country and miles in another. A pace of 5:30 per km is 8:51 per mile, 10.9 km/h.

Enter a pace like 5:30 or a speed and see all forms plus finish times for a mile, 5K, 10K, half marathon and marathon. The times assume the same pace throughout.
howTo: Enter a pace (5:30) or a speed.
Read the converted values and finish times.

faq.q: What is a 4 hour marathon pace?
faq.a: About 5:41 per km or 9:09 per mile.

keywords: min per km to min per mile
